factionRules.name: Drop Insertion
factionRules.timing: Setup, deployment and first/second turning points
factionRules.text: Set up the first third of the kill team normally. Each later whole third can be set up above with a Drop marker in your drop zone. As a Strategic Gambit in turning points 1 and 2, move Drop markers up to 4" horizontally (through Wall terrain in close quarters). Above operatives activate normally and may expend or land; follow the official placement, order and timing restrictions. Less than half can remain above at the end of turning point 1. Remove a Drop marker when readying in turning points 2 and 3; operatives still above at the end of turning point 2 are incapacitated.

factionRules.name: Grav-chute
factionRules.timing: Whenever a friendly operative is dropping

strategicGambits.name: Move Drop Markers
strategicGambits.text: You can move Drop markers up to 4" horizontally; in Tomb World close quarters this can be measured and moved through Wall terrain.

strategicGambits.name: Rapid Insertion
strategicGambits.text: Each friendly Trooper wholly within your drop zone can immediately perform a free Reposition, ending wholly within 3" of your drop zone.

abilities.name: Tempestus Veteran
abilities.text: Once per battle, use a Firefight ploy for 0CP if this is the specified Tempestus Aquilon operative, or use Command Re-roll for 0CP if this operative’s attack or defence dice was rolled for.

abilities.name: Command (1AP)
abilities.text: Select one other friendly Tempestus Aquilon operative (excluding Servo-Sentry) visible to and within 6". Until the end of its next activation, add 1 to its APL. Cannot be performed within control range of an enemy operative.

abilities.name: Grenadier
abilities.text: Can use frag, krak, smoke and stun grenades without counting towards limited uses selected as equipment. Improve the Hit stat of this operative’s frag or krak grenade by 1.

abilities.name: Salvo
abilities.text: Select up to two different valid targets that are not within control range of friendly operatives. Shoot this weapon against both, resolving each sequence separately.

abilities.name: Gunfight
abilities.text: After an enemy within 8" shoots this operative, it can make a free Shoot action against that enemy with focused hot-shot laspistols. Roll discarded enemy attack dice plus one, to a maximum of four; it may change to Engage.

abilities.name: Sniper’s Vantage
abilities.text: While on Vantage terrain and shooting an Engage-order operative at least 2" lower, all hot-shot long-las profiles have Severe.

abilities.name: Concealed Position
abilities.text: The concealed profile can only be used the first time this operative performs Shoot during the battle.

abilities.name: Vicious Knife Fighter
abilities.text: When fighting, after resolving your first attack die, immediately resolve another before your opponent.

abilities.name: Dynamic
abilities.text: After Shoot or Fight, perform a free Dash. This is allowed after Charge, using only remaining Charge move distance, to a maximum of 3".

abilities.name: Machine
abilities.text: Can only Dash, Fall Back, Reposition and Shoot. Cannot retaliate, assist in a fight, or use weapons not on its datacard.

abilities.name: Turret
abilities.text: Can perform two Shoot actions during its activation.
